Class AhpHostOptions

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.AhpHostOptions
@CopilotExperimental public final class AhpHostOptions extends Object
Options for in-process AHP hosting. Select at least one transport explicitly; no local listener is started by default. Factories must return the exact session registered on the owning client with the requested identity and settings. Release callbacks end a participation, not the application's session lifetime.
